facts.label: Earned leave entitlement in the United Kingdom
facts.quote: UK: 25 days plus bank holidays; carry-forward max 5 days, to be used by 31 March.

facts.label: Sick leave entitlement in India
facts.quote: India: 10 days/year (medical certificate required beyond 2 consecutive days).

facts.label: Sick leave entitlement in the United Kingdom
facts.quote: UK: statutory sick pay plus 10 days company sick pay.

facts.label: Maximum leave days approved by line manager only
facts.quote: ≤5 working days — line manager; 6–15 days — line manager and the Project Manager...

facts.label: Notice period required for leave >5 days
facts.quote: Employees on a client project must give **15 days' notice** for leave of more than 5 days, unless it is an emergency.
